title: How To Search For Verified Members In The Database
text:
## How To Search For Verified Members In The Database
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000059947
Verified members can be identified directly within the website's database using the is_verified field.

## Viewing the Verification Status
To see whether members have been verified, open Quick Edit for any Member:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12181111269/original/XBZfYeKuBbFrusExh0HIS4zEXANHtq_Jjg.png?1782514245 | alt: ]

## Searching for Verified Members
To search for verified members directly in the database, go to:
Developer Hub → MySQL Database
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12181111275/original/iLYZScgTjkc6WgrBWuCOX5Lw906TJl8oiA.png?1782514290 | alt: ]
Click on the database that ends with wording " directory ":
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12054483633/original/Qo-tp4PE72tVAqJVKA0caSFGscMCyujUwA.png?1564496078 | alt: ]
Open the users table.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12054483678/original/bMdCWNPY-q-jtwXsVG6l12ERKc0zjVWQTg.png?1564496102 | alt: ]
Click on SQL :
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12054483707/original/ZRD4t_G-fPAE22aQh27adsQ1T9nW6ZhBxQ.png?1564496123 | alt: ]
